verdict.rationale: Ramp offers a Checking Account, so this story applies. The evidence only documents reading account lists and balance history through the Banking API. Nothing shows a finance lead viewing account and routing numbers or generating a bank verification letter. Scope names such as bank_accounts:read and agent_account_numbers:read are related permissions, not documented features for this story.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can view account and routing numbers and generate a bank verification letter anytime
